items.title: KREX: Concurrent Kernel Benchmarking on Shared GPUs via Region-Granular Exclusivity
items.summary: LLM agents automate GPU kernel optimization by repeatedly composing candidates and measuring their duration on real GPUs. Existing systems preserve measurement fidelity by reserving a GPU for an entire agent session or benchmarking command. However, this results in poor utilization because only a small fraction of command execution requires exclusive GPU access. items.title: Cross-Model Autoscaling for Shared LLM Serving
items.summary: Multi-model LLM serving is moving toward shared MaaS clusters, where co-hosted models compete for a fixed GPU budget while each model experiences time-varying demand and must satisfy its own latency SLO. Existing LLM autoscalers remain largely model-local: their signals expose local runtime activity or delayed latency outcomes, and their scale-up or provisioning decisions do not directly determine how shared capacity should be allocated across competing models. items.title: ‘Send in the Clowns’: Viral video fuels claims Denmark trolled Trump and Rubio
items.summary: A viral video claims Danish officials played Judy Collins’ “Send in the Clowns” as US Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived for a Greenland signing ceremony, sparking claims of Danish “trolling”. Our checks of separate livestreams confirm the song really played and the video was not manipulated. Denmark has denied choosing the music, while the UN says it did not organise the event. Whilst the song was real, there is no evidence Denmark selected it deliberately. Vedika Bahl fact-checks.

items.title: Iran sees air, land travel chaos as US sanctions bite
items.summary: Flights between Iran and the United Arab Emirates have been suspended, following tighter US sanctions on Iran's aviation industry. The move effectively cuts Tehran off from Dubai, one of the region's most important commercial hubs. There are also huge backups near Iran's border with Turkey, as overland shipping routes struggle to fill the gaps. Also in this edition - Donald Trump and Xi Jinping hail strong ties between the US and China as they discuss AI, trade, and energy.
